errors.text_span: множество сини точки, разположени вдълбочено върху нея
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the blue dots are located on the solid line. The figure clearly shows two separate data series: one solid line and one scatter plot of points. The points are not markers on the line.

errors.text_span: Освен това, между основните етикети са визуализирани и по-малки, неетикетирани деления, които вероятно сочат месечни или квартални точки, но без конкретни числови означения.
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the existence of minor, unlabeled tick marks on the X-axis between the year labels. No such marks are present in the figure.

errors.text_span: Между тях са визуализирани по-малки, неетикетирани хоризонтални линии, които вероятно сочат интервали от 1000 левове.
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the existence of minor, unlabeled horizontal grid lines on the Y-axis. The only grid lines shown are for the major ticks at 2000-unit intervals.
The description states the solid line reaches about 14,000 levs in 2019, but the figure shows it reaches a plateau at approximately 15,000 levs during 2019.

errors.text_span: достигайки около 18 000 левове към края на годината
errors.evidence: The description claims the solid line reaches about 18,000 levs by the end of 2021. However, the figure shows the value at the boundary of 2021 and 2022 is significantly higher, at approximately 19,500 levs.

errors.text_span: последната точка е около 20 500 левове към края на 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the last data point is at about 20,500 levs, but the figure shows it is clearly higher, at approximately 21,000 levs.
The description speculates that the data points represent monthly or quarterly values. The figure itself does not provide this information, making it an unsupported interpretation.
